instructions.scope: Offline derived tables only. No APIs, price interpolation, dividend forecast generation, IV inversion, curve bootstrapping or simulation.
instructions.prices: Prefer known split-and-dividend-adjusted close for stocks/ETFs; index levels retain their explicitly configured price/total-return meaning. Unavailable adjusted data can produce explicitly labelled price-only returns. Do not add dividends to adjusted returns.
instructions.merge: Use one primary provider per instrument and return convention. Exact-basis close/index fallbacks need overlapping observations within tolerance and matching units/currency. Adjusted-price gap splicing is disabled until scales are explicitly reconciled. Conflicting duplicates are quarantined.
instructions.calendar: XNYS is the default for daily exchange-traded prices. Override calendar per instrument for other exchanges. Rates/FX retain native observation dates; no forward fill.
instructions.options: Field/spread filters produce IV candidates, not a validated arbitrage-free surface. IBKR model IV, optPrice, undPrice and pvDividend remain a coherent model group, distinct from quoted midpoint. Unknown quote age and incomplete forward conventions remain explicit.
instructions.expiry: ACT/365F uses calendar time. AM/PM times are configurable approximations for expiry when only a date was saved, not certified settlement timestamps. Last trading date is never substituted for expiry.
instructions.thresholds: 0.1% close discrepancy and 10% option relative spread are configurable diagnostic/selection choices, not universal market validity rules.
instructions.instruments: Optional overrides by archive request ID: calendar, provider_priority, index_return_type (price/gross_total_return/net_total_return), option_reference, expiration_timezone, expiration_time. No tickers are special-cased in Python.
